title: Job Application for Front End Engineer, Marketing at Anthropic
content:

In this role, you'll contribute to shipping high-quality web experiences across anthropic.com and claude.com — from interactive marketing pages and data visualizations to internal tooling that keeps our content operations running smoothly. You'll work closely with designers, engineers, and brand and content teams to [...] ## Key responsibilities

Own implementation of design system components and page templates across our web properties, with a focus on experiences that go beyond static content — interactive pages, data visualizations, and tools that communicate complex information clearly

Work within our headless CMS architecture, helping maintain and improve content modeling, structured data workflows, and the publishing experience [...] Collaborate closely with designers to bridge the gap between static design and living, interactive web experiences

Participate in migrations and site architecture projects, taking on defined scopes within larger efforts led by senior team members

Move quickly from concept to working prototype, iterating in close collaboration with the team
